name: Shopska Salata (Tomato, Cucumber, and Bell Pepper Salad)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 roasted peppers or fresh green bell peppers
2 spoonfuls chopped red onion or green onion
½ pound (225 g) white cheese (feta; optional)

steps: Cut the tomatoes, cucumbers and peppers in small pieces—cubes if possible.
Mix well with the parsley, onion, salt, and oil.
Serve with white cheese grated on top. Enjoy!

culture.text: Shopska salad is a cold salad popular throughout Southeastern Europe. It is Bulgaria's most famous salad and national dish.
